title: eriocoma wallowaensis
intro: Eriocoma wallowaensis, commonly known as Wallowa needle grass, is a species of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may aid in wound healing and reducing the risk of infections. The therapeutic actions of Eriocoma wallowaensis include antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help soothe skin irritations and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its potential benefits and uses.
